title.zh: FinCEN Ties $12.7B to Crypto Scams Run From Asian Compounds
title.en: FinCEN Ties $12.7B to Crypto Scams Run From Asian Compounds

current_state.zh: FinCEN ties roughly $12.7 billion in suspicious activity to crypto investment scams run from Southeast Asian compounds, based on 33,904 suspicious activity reports filed between September 2023 and December 2025.
